fields.rt-blog-html:
Discover our 2025 marketing calendar and don't miss a single date!

‍

January 2025

  • All month long: Dry January (alcohol-free month), Veganuary (eat vegan for 1 month)
  • January 1: New Year's Day (public holiday)
  • January 6: Epiphany (Galette des rois) 👑
  • January 8: Start of winter sales
  • January 9: World Corsican Day
  • January 12: Start of the Australian Open
  • January 16: Spicy Food Day 🌶
  • January 17: Italian Cuisine Day
  • January 18-19: Truffle Festival
  • January 19: International Pop Corn Day 🍿
  • January 20: Blue Monday
  • January 22: Grandfather's Day
  • January 25-26: Feast of Saint Vincent Tournante, patron saint of winegrowers 🍇
  • January 29: Chinese New Year

‍

February 2025

  • February 2: Candlemas
  • February 3: International No Straw Day
  • February 5: World Nutella Day
  • February 9: Pizza Day 🍕, Super Bowl
  • February 10: International Pulses Day 🥬
  • February 14: Valentine's Day ❤️
  • February 22: Start of the Salon International de l'Agriculture, Open That Bottle Night
  • February 28: Start of Ramadan (until March 29)

‍

March 2025

  • March 2: Grandmothers' Day 👵🏻
  • March 4: World Day Against Obesity, Mardi Gras
  • March 5: World Absinthe Day
  • March 8: International Women's Day
  • March 15: International Consumer Rights Day
  • March 17: St. Patrick's Day (Ireland's national holiday) 🇮🇪
  • March 18: World Recycling Day
  • March 20: Spring 🌷, International Meatless Day, Easter Sunday
  • March 22: World Water Day
  • March 24: European Artisanal Ice Cream Day 🍦
  • March 27: Cheese Day 🧀

‍

April 2025

  • April 1: International Joke Day (Poisson d'avril)
  • April 4: International Carrot Day 🥕
  • April 7: World Health Day 🏥
  • April 21: Easter Monday (public holiday)
  • April 22: Earth Day 🌍
  • April 30: Start of the Paris Fair (until May 11)

‍

‍

May 2025

  • May 1: Labour Day
  • May 2: World Tuna Day
  • May 3: World Sun Day ☀️
  • May 4: Star Wars Day
  • May 6: No Diet Day 🥗
  • May 13: World Cocktail Day, International Hummus Day, Cannes Film Festival 🎥
  • May 17: Eurovision
  • May 20: Whit Monday (public holiday)
  • May 21: World Tea and Whiskey Day
  • May 25: Mother's Day, Roland Garros begins 🎾
  • May 28: Hamburger Day 🍔
  • May 29: Ascension (public holiday)
  • May 30: Neighbours' Day
  • May 31: Champions League Final ⚽️
    ‍

June 2025

  • June 1: World Parents' Day
  • May 3: World Cider Day
  • June 5: World Environment Day
  • June 6: American National Donut Day 🍩, Start of National Agriculture Days
  • June 15: Father's Day
  • June 16: Tapas Day
  • June 18: Sushi Day 🍣
  • June 21: Summer Music Festival
  • June 25: Start of summer sales
  • June 27: World Pineapple Day 🍍
  • June 30: Wimbledon begins 🎾

‍

‍

July 2025

  • July 3: World No Plastic Bag Day
  • July 5: Tour de France 🚴, Start of summer vacation 
  • July 14: Bastille Day (public holiday)
  • July 17: World Emoji Day 😃
  • July 21: World Junk Food Day
  • July 24: Tequila Day

‍

August 2025

  • August 1: International French Fry Day 🍟, World Beer Day 🍺
  • August 12: International Youth Day
  • August 15: Assumption (public holiday)
  • August 25: Banana spilt day, US Open begins 🎾

‍

September 2025

  • September 1: Back to school 
  • September 2: World Coconut Day 🥥
  • September 5: International Charity Day
  • September 6-7: Grande Braderie de Lille
  • September 14-15-16: Mondial du fromage et des produits laitiers (World Cheese and Dairy Show) 
  • September 20: Oktoberfest begins 🍻
  • September 22: Autumn 🍂, car-free day
  • September 29: International Food Loss and Waste Awareness Day

‍

October 2025

  • October 1: Coffee Day, Vegetarian Day, World Chocolate Day 🍫
  • October 4: Vodka Day, World Smile Day
  • October 13: World Egg Day 🥚
  • October 16: World Food and Bread Day
  • October 19: World Breast Cancer Day
  • October 20: International Cooks' Day
  • October 21: International Nacho Day
  • October 24: World Champagne Day
  • October 25: Pasta Day 🍝
  • October 26: Changeover to winter time
  • October 31: Halloween 🎃

‍

‍

November 2025

  • All month long: Movember
  • November 1: Vegan Day
  • November 3: World Sandwich Day 🥪
  • November 6: World Paperless Day
  • November 7: International Merlot Day
  • November 10: International Trainees' Day, Students' Day
  • November 14: World Diabetes Day
  • October 17: World Day Against Poverty 
  • November 20: Beaujolais Nouveau festival
  • November 27: Thanksgiving 🦃
  • November 28: Black Friday 🏷

‍

December 2025

  • December 1: Advent calendar, Cyber Monday
  • December 13: Raclette Day 🧀
  • December 21: Winter

‍
